question: Can widening WSP153's intervention-conditioned GF(2) sparse monomial version space to include genuinely third-order interactions reduce confident out-of-family errors at the exact same charged effects, without dropping in-class coverage below a frozen minimum? Can the learner detect off-family conditions that remain information-theoretically indistinguishable?
primary_hypothesis: At matched 8 charged actions, an unlabelled expanded algebraic version space with all monomials through degree 3 and up to 3 active terms (12,384 candidates) retains conditional unanimity; abstention, not overconfident guesswork, guards against cubic off-family violations of the original 22-term class.

freeze.base_hypothesis: WSP153 exact 22 GF2 monomials, choose up to 3; 1794 rules
freeze.expanded_hypothesis: 42 monomials degrees 0,1,2,3; choose up to 3; 12,384 candidate rules
freeze.selected_actions: 4 common x=1,2,4,8, plus 4 existing WSP153 active disagreement interventions, paid per policy, same rows for all methods
freeze.readout: only when every surviving exact hypothesis agrees; empty version space => abstain globally, never force a label
freeze.prior: No cross-world learning or warm past-world memory. Models fit each world only from its charged do observations. Every held prediction sealed before effects read.
freeze.independent_controls: Unchanged WSP153 sparse version-space baseline and independently computed truth-table symbolic parity, fully fitted CART and unchanged WSP151 Bayes on identical 8 actions
freeze.fabricated_cohorts: Fresh WSP154|FAKE| source-only generators, never WSP153 world indices, seed streams, results or source. 12 ON worlds across AND2, OR2, XOR2, COMPOSE3; 12 OFF across CUBIC3, CUBIC_XOR, PAIR_TRIPLE, ODD4, EXACT2OF4, QUAD4. Each six form-world pair repeated twice with fresh source identities.
freeze.held: All remaining 56 contexts after exact 8 paid do effects; same held per model; no query to any effect during acquisition
freeze.outcomes: Primary: OFF confident-wrong / all 12x56 held queries; secondary: ON confident-coverage and correct-vs-CART; split OFF cubic-representable vs extended-nonrepresentable, exact symbolic parity and cold/deterministic repeat
freeze.adversarial: Construct for each unseen x a one-hot truth-table alternative (off model class), identical on paid observations and contradictory to any predicted label at x. Report impossibility of universal off-family certification, not absolute model safety.
freeze.constraints: no re-use of original WSP149 effect source or WSP151 reserved source cohorts; no native Yggdrasil weight writing, no artificial promotion, no trusted generator exposure; deterministic standard library only
freeze.nonresource_digest: For dual OS parity hash all world action/label custody and evaluation scores excluding CPU/wall

limitations: Supplied algebraic grammar, not autonomous model-discovered concepts. Full conventional trained control remains mandatory. A positive fabricated development would not be native or scientific PASS. An out-of-class world can coincide with all 8 actions and reverse an unseen prediction, so any finite-source guarantee is class-conditional.
